customers.evidence: our purpose is to develop the affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress

employees.evidence: Throughout our history, Chevron has been a place where trust, respect and humility define our culture

dei.evidence: We have an inclusive work environment that values the uniqueness and diversity of individual talents, experiences and ideas.

environment.evidence: Our actions will make energy and global supply chains more sustainable

community.evidence: We work together – and with our partners – to achieve solutions and breakthroughs that benefit our shareholders and society.

shareholders.evidence: We aim to deliver industry-leading results.

integrity.evidence: We earn trust and respect by acting with integrity and operating with the highest ethical standards.

safety.evidence: We aim to lead our industry in health, safety and environmental performance.

innovation.evidence: Meeting the world’s growing energy needs demands pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice throughout, with headline value pairs. Purpose and vision lead, addressing energy access and progress before stakeholders. Commitments mix absolute wording (is our highest priority) with hedged (we aim, we intend). Distinctive phrasing: human progress and ever-cleaner energy. Safety and environment are fused under one headline, while shareholder returns get little explicit emphasis.
